## Checklist

- [ ] The URL loads and returns 200. I checked it today.
- [ ] It is public. A stranger with no account can open it.
- [ ] The description is one line, factual, no marketing, no emoji, ends in a period.
- [ ] Limitations are in the line: platform, model family, or that it is a small build rather than a product.
- [ ] It does not claim behaviour the thing does not have.
- [ ] It is in the right section and under the right heading, and I did not reorder anything else.
- [ ] It exposes no private information and no destructive action to anonymous visitors.

### Only for a tool, repository or node pack

- [ ] A commit in the last 18 months, not archived, not blocked.
- [ ] Comfy is load-bearing, not one optional backend among many.
- [ ] If this is a node pack, it is published in the [Comfy Registry](https://registry.comfy.org/).

### Only for Built with Comfy or Work made with Comfy

- [ ] The public statement of the Comfy connection is quoted below with its source URL.
- [ ] The entry states what the thing is plainly, with no caveat about how well sourced it is.

<!-- Quote the sentence that establishes the Comfy connection, and give the URL it came from. -->

### Only if you are claiming the From Comfy heading

- [ ] Comfy Org builds, maintains or officially supports this. A partnership, a customer relationship or an integration is not enough.
